tour.title: Onboarding Tour
tour.description: Re-run the guided walkthrough of TeslaSync features

launcher.title: Take a tour
launcher.subtitle: Guided walkthroughs for every major feature.

main.title: TeslaSync overview
main.description: The 60-second tour: sidebar, dashboard layout, edit mode, and keyboard shortcuts.

alerts.title: Alerts & Alert Studio
alerts.description: Filter, snooze, and design alert rules with conditions, channels, and test runs.

charging.title: Charging insights
charging.description: Sessions, cost analysis, and the charging-curve viewer for any session.

drives.title: Drives & replay
drives.description: Drive history, Saved Views, and the trip replay scrubber with markers.

vehicles.title: Vehicles & access
vehicles.description: Fleet overview, per-vehicle detail tabs, and managing drivers/access.

automations.title: Automation builder
automations.description: Triggers, conditions, actions, and conflict detection for rules.

productPreferences.title: Workspace preferences
productPreferences.description: Choose how TeslaSync prioritizes information when this browser opens. These presentation preferences never change permissions or backend authorization.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Prioritizes daily vehicle status, charging, battery health, and ownership costs.

fleetOperator.label: Fleet operator
fleetOperator.description: Prioritizes fleet readiness, alerts, automations, commands, and service operations.

analyst.label: Analyst
analyst.description: Prioritizes reports, trends, efficiency, driving evidence, and data exports.

administrator.label: Administrator
administrator.description: Prioritizes system health, diagnostics, integrations, data controls, and settings.

landing.label: Preferred landing page
landing.hint: Applied only when TeslaSync first opens at the root URL; Dashboard remains available from navigation.

defaultVehicle.label: Default active vehicle
defaultVehicle.hint: Used on a fresh app load. Selecting a vehicle here also applies it to the current global vehicle scope.

defaultRange.label: Default analysis window
defaultRange.hint: Becomes the active global analysis window immediately and is reused when no more specific range is stored.

contextualHelp.label: Contextual inline help
contextualHelp.hint: Show concise explanations beside advanced settings and analytical metrics. Help remains available from the status line.

releaseHighlights.label: Contextual release highlights
releaseHighlights.hint: Surface relevant product changes after an update. Full release notes remain available from Help & support.

settings.title: Settings & preferences
settings.description: Theme, units, notification channels, and Saved Views — all in one place.

debugger.title: FSM Debugger
debugger.description: Timeline, source-layer badges, freeze/step controls, and shareable permalinks.
